result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major text truncation problem in restaurant name and a minor layout issue with partially visible content at the bottom.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated in the rightmost card under 'Fastest near you' section - the full name is likely 'Trattoria Piccolo' but the last character is cut off
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant names have sufficient space within their cards or use text ellipsis (...) if names are too long, rather than hard clipping

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza with -20% discount) is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen, showing only the top portion of the card
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the 'Popular right now' section or adjust card spacing to ensure complete card visibility without requiring scroll, or make the cut-off more intentionally designed
